grounding.scope: Occupational context only; no source establishes any candidate claim. All case facts and metrics are invented.

generation_policy.allowed: Select, reorder, compress or translate supplied facts without changing meaning.
forbidden: Invent additional metrics, employers, degrees, licenses or dates.
Convert team results into personal sole ownership.
Present synthetic cases as genuine applicants.
generation_policy.missing_information: Ask or omit; never fill from occupational statistics.
